name: 布桥15着3.0
author: Iliary
description:
[highlight]布桥15着
[gold]3.0
[white]
或称贴核15接收台
[lightgray]
总运力300，布桥完美均压。 
四布桥运输，叠二布桥回核。
调整叠二布桥可直接贴核。

-序切着陆控制
需要至少一只flare探测核心。
序切逻辑会在因发射量不足卡着陆时按核心物品数量倒序调整着陆物品。在战役中可跑满发射量。
将逻辑链接到信息板查看序切情况。
默认不选择发射沙废煤孢。

[highlight]Phase-Bridge 15 Landing Pads
[gold]3.0
[white]

Also known as the Core-Adjacent 15-Pad Receiver.

[lightgray]
unable to stack.
Total throughput: 300.
Phase bridges provide perfectly balanced distribution.

Four phase bridges handle transport, while stacked dual phase bridges return items to the core.

By adjusting the stacked dual phase bridges, the design can be placed directly adjacent to the core.

* Sequential Landing Control

Requires at least one Flare to detect the core.

When landing pads become bottlenecked due to insufficient launch throughput, the sequential-switching logic dynamically adjusts the received item type according to core inventory, prioritizing the least-stocked resources first.
In Campaign, this allows launch throughput to remain fully utilized.

Link the logic to a message block to monitor switching status.

Sand, scrap, coal, and spores are excluded from launch selection by default.
